backlog.spec: Set MATRIX_LR = 0.05.

backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSSSL"... or try "L" only to see if full context everywhere helps or sliding windows speed training more. Try WINDOW_PATTERN = "SL".

backlog.spec: If logits use a softcap (e.g. 15), change it to 30; if none, add 30*tanh(x/30) before the loss.
backlog.title: Logit softcap tweak

backlog.spec: Ensure the attention c_proj and MLP c_proj weights are zero-initialized; if already, instead scale residual lambda init to 0.9.
backlog.title: Zero-init output projections check

backlog.spec: If value embeddings are used on alternating layers, add them to all layers, or if absent, add value embeddings on the last few layers with a gated mix.
backlog.title: Untie value-embedding gating strength

backlog.spec: Set the final Muon momentum to 0.97 and shorten the momentum ramp to the first 100 steps.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter/higher

backlog.spec: Reduce Muon Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 to save time per step, if configurable.
backlog.title: Muon NS steps 4

backlog.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before the optimizer step if absent; if present, remove it for speed.
backlog.title: Disable gradient clipping / add clip 1.0

backlog.spec: Cast the token embedding weights to bf16 to cut memory bandwidth and allow DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128 without overflow if feasible, reducing micro-steps.
backlog.title: torch.compile max-autotune off, bf16 embeddings

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 and keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 (so grad accumulation is 1 step if sequence length 2048 gives 131072 tokens per micro-batch; adjust only the constant). Scale MATRIX_LR by about 0.9 and leave other LRs unchanged. More optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s should help the small model.
backlog.title: Batch 2**17 with LR retune

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 5 and ASPECT_RATIO = 90 (model_dim 450, rounded up to a multiple of HEAD_DIM=128 as the existing code does, so check the result is 512). This gives a shallower, wider model that gets more tokens in 300 s. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Depth 5 with higher aspect ratio

backlog.spec: Add a batch size schedule: for the first 20% of the time budget use half the gradient accumulation steps (effective batch 2**17), then switch to the full 2**18. Scale the loss normalization to match the number of micro-steps used. This gives faster early progress and a stable late phase.
backlog.title: Batch-size ramp up

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown in the LR schedule function with a cosine shape: once progress passes 1-WARMDOWN_RATIO, set the multiplier to 0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) where t goes 0 to 1 across the warmdown. Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO at 0.5 and the final LR fraction at 0.
backlog.title: Cosine warmdown shape

backlog.spec: After the existing QK normalization (add RMS norm to q and k if not present), multiply q by a learnable per-head scalar initialized to 1.2 (stored as a parameter in the scalar Adam group). This sharpens attention, which is useful for short training runs.
backlog.title: Attention logit QK-norm scale learnable

backlog.spec: Add light data noise: during training only, replace 2% of input token ids (not targets) with random token ids from the vocabulary before the forward pass. Evaluation is untouched. This tests whether regularization helps; the data is seen less than one epoch, so expect it to hurt, but it is a bold check.
backlog.title: Dropout-free token masking augmentation

backlog.spec: Reduce the number of Newton-Schulz iterations in Muon from 5 to 3 (or 4). The saved optimizer time gives more steps within 300 s. Keep the coefficients as they are.
backlog.title: Muon NS steps 3 for speed

backlog.spec: Initialize the per-layer x0 residual scalars (resid lambda for x0) at 0.2 rather than the current value, and set the residual lambdas to 1.0. This strengthens the embedding shortcut in a shallow model. Only the init constants change.
backlog.title: Skip-connection from embedding to every layer, stronger

backlog.spec: Make sure the Adam groups use fused=True, and use torch.compile with mode='max-autotune-no-cudagraphs' on the model. Keep numerics the same. Measure whether step throughput improves, so more steps fit within 300 s.
backlog.title: Eager-free bf16 autocast plus fused Adam check

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 and also set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.65. Lower weight decay and a longer warmdown suit a short training run with a small model. This is a combined two-constant change.
backlog.title: Weight decay scaled with LR schedule off at end, wd 0.1
